install: set -euo pipefail; REPO_DIR="$(pwd)"; uv sync --dev; "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python" -m ipykernel install --user --name ds-ml --display-name "Python 3.11 (DS/ML)"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF "export VIRTUAL_ENV=\"$REPO_DIR/.venv\"" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "export VIRTUAL_ENV=\"$REPO_DIR/.venv\"" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF "export PATH=\"$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin:\$PATH\"" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "export PATH=\"$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin:\$PATH\"" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export MPLBACKEND="Agg"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export MPLBACKEND="Agg"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
